title: The Will Reading
setting: A country manor on a stormy night
narrative: Manor owner Edmund Harrow was found dead in the library at nine o'clock, just before the will was to be read. Everyone assumed nine was the hour of the murder — until someone noticed the library clock had been stopped at nine, and the body was cold. The real hour was seven, and eight people were in the manor that evening.

suspects.name: Clara Harrow
suspects.alibi: In the drawing room with guests from six o'clock to ten.
suspects.secret: She practises her surprised face.

suspects.name: Beatrice Hale
suspects.alibi: Says she was turning down beds upstairs from seven to nine, but no beds were turned down and her apron was found in the library.
suspects.secret: She has served the family for thirty years.

suspects.name: Lucian Frey
suspects.alibi: On the phone with the county clerk; the call log covers the evening.
suspects.secret: He drafts wills he never reads aloud.

suspects.name: Gordon Vale
suspects.alibi: Mending fences by lantern light in view of the kitchen window.
suspects.secret: He grows roses for the manor's graves.

suspects.name: Priya Nair
suspects.alibi: In the kitchen through dinner service; the kitchen staff confirm it.
suspects.secret: She salts the soup twice.

suspects.name: Alan Pierce
suspects.alibi: At the village surgery until eight; the surgery log proves it.
suspects.secret: He prescribes walks for every ailment.

suspects.name: Miriam Sloane
suspects.alibi: Playing cards in the drawing room with Clara and the guests from six to ten.
suspects.secret: She cheats at cards and loses anyway.

suspects.name: Theo Lind
suspects.alibi: In the garage all evening; the gardener saw him there.
suspects.secret: He polishes the car twice a week.

clues.text: Drawing-room guests place Clara and Miriam at cards from six o'clock to ten.
The call log shows Lucian on the phone with the county clerk all evening.
The kitchen window view places Gordon mending fences by lantern light.
Kitchen staff confirm Priya was in the kitchen through dinner service.
The surgery log shows Alan at the village surgery until eight.
Gordon saw Theo in the garage all evening.

redHerrings.text: The manor cat knocked a vase off the hall table at midnight.
A guest swore the storm spoke his name through the chimney.
The will's envelope was sealed with the wrong colour wax.
Someone practised the piano in the music room after midnight.

solution.explanation: Beatrice killed Harrow in the study at seven, moved the body to the library, and stopped the library clock at nine to fix a false hour of death. She did it because Harrow was about to dismiss her after thirty years without a pension, and the will was to be read that night.

deductionPath.text: Clara was at cards in the drawing room.
Miriam was at cards beside her.
Lucian was on the phone with the clerk.
Gordon mended fences in view of the kitchen window.
Priya was in the kitchen through dinner service.
Alan was at the surgery until eight.
Theo was in the garage all evening.
With all seven others placed across the true hour, only Beatrice Hale has no account of seven o'clock — and her apron was in the library.
